title: Echo Shards as a Warden Drop
description: Adds echo shards to the Warden's loot table.
body:
Echo shards are dropped upon the death of a warden. 1–2 shards are dropped each time. This can be increased to a maximum of 5 with the Looting enchantment.

A warden still drops a single sculk catalyst upon death, unaffected by Looting.
